## Description

Destroys Progress Bar HUD text that was created by [Create Progress Bar HUD Text](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/create%2Bprogress%2Bbar%2Bhud%2Btext).

## Snippet

```
Destroy Progress Bar HUD Text(Last Text ID);
```

**Parameters**: ==_Text ID_==

> ==**Text ID**==
> _Type: **Text ID**, Default: **[Last Text ID](/wiki/articles/last+text+id)**_
